title: El Sendero Luminoso ft. Alex Honnold | The North Face
summary: A short film of Alex Honnold free soloing El Sendero Luminoso, a 2,500-foot route in El Potrero Chico, Mexico, in a little over three hours with no rope. It was made by The North Face with climbing footage and music.
why: It is linked whenever Honnold or free soloing comes up, as a gripping and frightening example of extreme climbing.

quote.text: one of the most frightening videos I have ever seen
